newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican president to visit Atlanta April 27-30.
newsitem.headline: Mexican president to visit Atlanta April 27-30.

text.p: The Mexican Congress on Thursday authorised President Ernesto Zedillo to leave the country from April 27 to 30 for a working visit to Atlanta.

Zedillo will speak at the official launching of the 24-hour Spanish-language service of Cable News Network (CNN) and participate in a forum on the "Agenda for the Americas" hosted by former U.S. President Jimmy Carter, according to the decree approved by both houses of congress.
He also will meet with journalists from Cox Newspapers Inc., owners of 20 newspapers in six U.S. states, and meet with other business leaders in the state of Georgia.
Mexican presidents need the permission of the Senate and the Chamber of Deputies in order to leave the country.
